evidence_quotes.agenda: 'What are your biggest concerns on your move?' — asked right after confirming the date, before any logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A applied — customer said 'really, no concerns,' just described the scope (big items only, DIY-ing the small stuff).
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Estimate-variability framing with named factors landed ('we're just moving the big stuff here'). No rate-commit line, no explicit pay-less-if-faster line, no self-prep tip, no 'does that feel fair' check.

top_strength: Handled a genuinely complex big-items-only, two-address move (with an address-lookup snag) with real patience and precision, and offered a graceful no-pressure path when he needed to check with his wife.
coaching_note: Strong call overall, close to Green — the agenda question landed well up front, but Communication (day-before call, crew lead name) never got mentioned, and there was no explicit pay-less-if-faster or self-prep framing to reinforce the value of a bigger, pricier estimate like this one.
